products.pds_title: Tick Cruise Travel Insurance – Product Disclosure Statement
products.geographic_scope: Cruise itineraries with selectable destination regions: Domestic (Australian territorial waters/international waters with shore excursions on the Australian mainland; no international port stops), Pacific (listed island countries incl. NZ, PNG), Pacific and Domestic (Pacific destinations with docking at an Australian port after departure), Asia (listed countries only), Asia and Domestic (Asia destinations with docking at an Australian port), Worldwide Excluding (worldwide excluding USA/Canada/Mexico/Caribbean/Central & South America and Antarctica), Worldwide Including (worldwide including USA/Canada/Mexico/Caribbean/Central & South America and Antarctica – cruises only). Excludes sanctioned/embargoed countries as listed.
products.maximum_trip_duration_options: Up to 42 days (all ages permitted for this level).
products.eligibility_rules: Available only to Australian citizens/permanent residents or non-permanent residents with valid Medicare, Private Health Fund or Overseas Student Travel Insurance in Australia; evidence may be required. Applicants must be 79 or under at application (level-specific age caps apply). Policy must be purchased before trip commences. Purchaser must be 18+; dependent children under 18 may be covered when accompanied and named.
products.age_eligibility_notes: Product-wide maximum age to apply is 79 unless a lower cap applies to the selected level. Basic shows a 69 years of age or under cap at application (Level of Cover grid).
products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Cooling-off 14 days for full refund if no claim made and trip not commenced. After 14 days, pro-rata refund of unused cover less non-recoverable government charges/taxes if no claim made and no rights exercised.
products.excess_options: $200 standard excess per person, per section, per event. Optional Excess Eliminator available to remove all excesses except any increased medical excesses noted for certain covered activities.

excess_rules.amount: $200 per section per person per event
excess_rules.basis: Deducted from each payable claim; Nil excess applies where shown as Nil in the benefit table.
excess_rules.evidence: p5 Excess; p17 Important Information; p14 Table notes

products.emergency_medical_limit: Unlimited (outside Australia only; onboard medical/evacuation covered; no medical treatment cover in Australia or when ship is tied up in an Australian port)
products.emergency_dental_limit: $500 (emergency dental for immediate relief of pain only)
products.luggage_single_item_limit: $500 per item/pair/set (general items); no cover for laptops, cameras or other valuables under Basic.
products.electronics_or_valuables_limit: No cover for laptops, tablets, mobile phones, cameras, video cameras or other valuables.
products.personal_accident_limit: Nil (no cover under Section F at this level)
products.covid_cover_summary: General COVID-19 exclusions apply. No cover unless specifically provided under Section M; Basic level does not include Section M.

cruise_benefits.conditions: Economy class only; must claim from transport provider first; written confirmation required.

cruise_benefits.conditions: Only available on Standard/Top.

cruise_benefits.conditions: Only available on Budget/Standard/Top (E3) and Standard/Top (E5).

products.limit_basis_notes: Unless otherwise stated, limits apply per insured person per trip (Table heading).
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: No cover for pre-existing medical conditions under Basic/Budget. For Standard/Top only, cover may be available if you declare, are assessed/accepted and pay any additional premium. General exclusions for undiagnosed/awaiting tests, travel against medical advice, terminal prognosis before end date.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Pregnancy/childbirth are not illnesses/injuries. Cover only for complications of pregnancy and childbirth as defined. Section A cancellation may apply if you become pregnant after purchase and will be >30 weeks at start/during trip (or >20 weeks for multiples), or if a doctor certifies you are unfit due to complications. Section B1 excludes treatment after 30th week and non-complications.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: No cover under Sections A, C1 or C2 for events resulting directly/indirectly from medical conditions known before policy issue that affect a non-travelling relative, a non-insured travelling companion, or a person you plan to stay with.

excluded_activities.activity: Activities listed as excluded (examples: off-piste without professional guide, ski/snowboard fun parks, mountaineering with climbing/ice equipment, competitive contact sports, scuba >30m, yachting in international waters, etc.)
excluded_activities.evidence: p56 Table of excluded sports & activities

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Section K is not included under Basic. Where applicable on other levels: cover reimburses the rental car insurance excess only; must comply with rental agreement; nominated drivers only; excludes certain vehicle classes (e.g., commercial vehicles, buses, full-size vans on truck chassis, campers, motorhomes, trailers, motorbikes/mopeds, any <4 wheels, limousines); excludes wear/tear and tyres unless coincident with covered loss.
products.luggage_conditions: Proof of ownership required; depreciation applies; no cover for various items (e.g., sunglasses, dentures, perishable goods); laptops/phones/cameras/valuables must be carried in hand luggage unless government requires check-in; unattended or unsecured items excluded; vehicle thefts require locked compartment and evidence of forcible entry; mobile device claims require IMEI and carrier block.

depreciation_rules.item_category: Phones, electrical/communication devices, computers, photographic equipment, tablets, electronics, clothing
depreciation_rules.evidence: p34 Depreciation table; p35 similar table

general_exclusions.details: No cover unless accepted (Standard/Top only). Various specific conditions in last 2 years/12 months excluded unless accepted.
general_exclusions.evidence: p19-21 General Exclusions 1-3; p7 Health conditions

general_exclusions.details: No cover for circumstances you ought to have been aware of at policy issue.
No claim in Australia when cruise ship has been docked in an Australian port for more than 48 hours at time of loss (except stated sections).
General exclusion for COVID-19/epidemic/pandemic losses except as provided under Section M.
general_exclusions.evidence: p22 General Exclusions 33-34; p8 Important limitations – COVID-19

general_exclusions.details: No cover when travelling to areas under DFAT ‘Do not travel’ or sanctioned/embargoed countries.
general_exclusions.evidence: p20 General Exclusion 13; p4 destination note; p22 General Exclusion 35

general_exclusions.exclusion: Manual labour, humanitarian/missionary work, working with animals
general_exclusions.details: Excluded activities.
Rider must wear helmet and hold valid licence appropriate for country and equivalent in Australia.
No cover for refusal/failure to provide services due to financial default.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover for travel to countries/areas subject to ‘Do not travel’ advisories (DFAT Smartraveller) or to embargoed/sanctioned territories. Policy cannot provide cover/benefits where prohibited by sanctions law.
products.claims_process_summary: Register any claim within 30 days after completion of travel (late notice may reduce claim). Provide information in English or officially translated; supply proof of ownership/value and proof of event within requested timeframe. Excess applies per section/person/event. Settlement may be repair/replace/store credit/cash with depreciation.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 Overseas Emergency Assistance Helpline: +61 2 9333 3963. Contact as soon as possible for hospitalisation >24h, surgery or if you require approval for hospitalisation/evacuation/return travel.
products.premium_factors: Destination and length of trip; selected level of cover; number of travellers and their ages; optional upgrades (e.g., natural disaster, winter sports, excess waiver). Premiums include applicable government charges (GST, Stamp Duty).

Cruise Travel Insurance
Product Disclosure Statement
Effective: 01 April 2026

This insurance is issued, distributed and administered by the insurer: Europ Assistance Australia Pty Ltd (“Europ Assistance”), trading as Tick Travel Insurance. ABN: 71 140 219 594 ASFL Number 552106
Tick Cruise Travel Insurance provides cover for one trip up to a maximum duration that you select for your trip
There are four levels of cover available under this Tick Cruise Travel Insurance: Tick Basic Tick Budget Tick Standard Tick Top
B1 Medical and other expenses outside Australia – Unlimited ... Dental treatment $500
A Cancelling your trip before departure – Basic: Nil
C2 Additional emergency expenses – Basic $5,000

E1 Personal belongings and baggage – Basic $2,000 ... Including: laptops, tablets, mobile phones, cameras and video cameras item limit – No Cover ... Including: all other items single article limit/pair or set of items limit – $500
G Personal liability – Basic $1,000,000
We are not obligated to pay a claim relating to a pre-existing medical condition if you have a Basic or Budget cover.
Cooling Off period ... within 14 days of purchasing it
You must register any claim within 30 days after completion of your travel.
Age Limits at the date of application – 69 years of age or under (Basic column)

products.personal_accident_limit: Event 1(a) Death (18–65): $10,000; Event 1(b) Death of dependent child/insured <18: $15,000; Event 1(c) All benefits for insured 66+: $15,000; Event 2 Permanent Paraplegia/Quadriplegia: $25,000; Event 3 Permanent total loss of sight: $25,000; Event 4 Permanent loss of use of one or more limbs: $25,000.
products.loss_of_income_limit: $10,400 (max $1,733.33 per month up to 6 months; 30-day waiting period after return)
products.covid_cover_summary: Section M1: Cancellation/amendment or trip disruption only where you are medically diagnosed with COVID-19 after purchase; reasonable additional travel/accommodation to catch up overseas. Section M2: COVID-19 medical expenses outside Australia (including repatriation up to $50,000 and funeral overseas up to $10,000). No cover for government travel bans, border closures, quarantine not arising from your diagnosis, or costs after return to Australia.

cruise_benefits.conditions: Confinement must be confirmed in writing by ship’s medical officer.

cruise_benefits.limit: Up to $100 per completed 12 hours up to $1,000
cruise_benefits.conditions: Delay >12 hours; evidence and receipts required; exclusions apply.
Applies only if total number of docked ports is fewer than scheduled; documentation required.

cruise_benefits.benefit: Baggage before boarding (E3) and baggage delay before boarding (E5)
cruise_benefits.conditions: E3/E5 commence up to 72 hours prior to Australian departure until cruise leaves first Australian port.
Must resume within 60 days of return; prior approval required; follows a covered C1 event.
Hijack >24 hours; written confirmation required.
Final inward flight delay >24 hours; receipts and transport company confirmation required.

optional_add_ons.plan_effect: Top: A (Cancellation) Yes; C1 (Cut trip short) Yes; C2 (Additional expenses) Yes; C3 (Missed cruise departure) Yes.
optional_add_ons.conditions: Medical cover for natural disasters is automatically included on international policies without purchasing this option; upgrade extends cancellation/disruption sections; no cover for known events at purchase.
optional_add_ons.evidence: p5; p17 Natural Disaster Cover table

optional_add_ons.plan_effect: Adds winter sports equipment, hire, lift pass, ski pack, piste closure, avalanche cover subject to limits.
optional_add_ons.conditions: Must be shown on policy schedule; activity list/restrictions apply; additional premium; no cover if not purchased.

optional_add_ons.plan_effect: Specify items up to $4,000 per item (max $6,000 combined) with $200 excess.
optional_add_ons.conditions: Receipts/valuations required; only available on Top level.
optional_add_ons.evidence: p17 Additional Specified Items Cover table; p34 Section E2

optional_add_ons.plan_effect: Removes standard $200 excess except increased medical excesses for certain activities.

products.limit_basis_notes: Unless otherwise stated, limits apply per insured person per trip (Table heading).
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: For Standard/Top, pre-existing conditions may be covered only if disclosed, assessed and accepted by the insurer with any required additional premium shown on the policy schedule. Undiagnosed conditions/awaiting tests, travel against medical advice, or terminal prognosis expected before end date are excluded.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Pregnancy/childbirth are not illnesses/injuries. Cover only for complications of pregnancy and childbirth as defined. Section A cancellation may apply if you become pregnant after purchase and will be >30 weeks at start/during trip (or >20 weeks for multiples), or if a doctor certifies you are unfit due to complications. Section B1 excludes treatment after 30th week and non-complications.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: No cover under Sections A, C1 or C2 for events resulting directly/indirectly from medical conditions known before policy issue that affect a non-travelling relative, a non-insured travelling companion, or a person you plan to stay with.

excluded_activities.activity: Activities listed as excluded (examples: off-piste without professional guide, ski/snowboard fun parks, mountaineering with climbing/ice equipment, competitive contact sports, scuba >30m, yachting in international waters, etc.)
excluded_activities.evidence: p56 Table of excluded sports & activities

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Reimburses the rental car insurance excess only; must comply with rental agreement; nominated drivers only; excludes certain vehicle classes (e.g., commercial vehicles, buses, full-size vans on truck chassis, campers, motorhomes, trailers, motorbikes/mopeds, any <4 wheels, limousines); excludes wear/tear and tyres unless coincident with covered loss.
products.luggage_conditions: Proof of ownership required; depreciation applies; excluded items listed; laptops/phones/cameras/valuables must be carried in hand luggage unless government requires check-in; unattended or unsecured items excluded; vehicle theft conditions apply; mobile device claims require IMEI and carrier block.

depreciation_rules.item_category: Phones, electrical/communication devices, computers, photographic equipment, tablets, electronics, clothing
depreciation_rules.evidence: p34 Depreciation table; p35 similar table

general_exclusions.details: No cover unless accepted (Standard/Top only). Various specific conditions in last 2 years/12 months excluded unless accepted.
general_exclusions.evidence: p19-21 General Exclusions; p7 Health conditions

general_exclusions.details: No cover for DFAT ‘Do not travel’ or sanctioned regions.
General exclusion except where Section M applies.
No cover for provider insolvency/default.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover for travel to countries/areas subject to ‘Do not travel’ advisories (DFAT Smartraveller) or to embargoed/sanctioned territories. Policy cannot provide cover/benefits where prohibited by sanctions law.
products.claims_process_summary: Register any claim within 30 days after completion of travel; provide required documentation; excess per section/person/event applies where relevant.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 Overseas Emergency Assistance Helpline: +61 2 9333 3963. Contact as soon as possible for hospitalisation >24h, surgery or if you require approval for hospitalisation/evacuation/return travel.
products.premium_factors: Destination and length of trip; selected level of cover; number of travellers and their ages; optional upgrades (e.g., natural disaster, winter sports, excess waiver).

data._document_notes: This PDS is cruise-specific and provides four cover levels (Basic, Budget, Standard, Top) for single-trip policies. OCR of the Level of Cover grid (pages 3–4) is partially truncated; in particular, the Budget and Top columns for Maximum Trip Duration and the per-level age limits are not fully legible. The extraction reflects clear entries (e.g., Basic 42 days and 69-year cap; Standard/Top duration patterns by destination/age) and leaves ambiguous Budget duration text unfilled. There is also an apparent inconsistency in Section K: ‘Rental car’ is defined to include motorcycles/mopeds (p43), yet the Section K exclusions later state no cover when renting motorbikes, motorcycles or mopeds and any vehicle with fewer than four wheels (p44). Destination availability rows include OCR artifacts (e.g., repeated words); definitions and region lists on page 4 govern.
